msaada.title: Help & Support
msaada.subtitle: We're here to help. Check our frequently asked questions or contact us directly.

faqs.question: What is Nusrah.co.tz?
faqs.answer: Nusrah.co.tz is a platform connecting people with sincere intentions of finding a life partner for marriage, built on respect, honesty, privacy, and Islamic values.

faqs.question: Is Nusrah a regular dating site?
faqs.answer: No. Nusrah is focused on finding a partner for marriage, not short-term relationships or entertainment.

faqs.question: Who can sign up for Nusrah?
faqs.answer: Anyone who meets Nusrah's Terms of Use and has genuine intentions of finding a life partner can sign up.

faqs.question: Do I have to be Muslim?
faqs.answer: Nusrah is built from an Islamic perspective, but our main goal is to bring people together and help them build strong foundations for marriage. Because of this, Nusrah welcomes people of all faiths, with no discrimination based on religion.

faqs.question: What information do I need for sign-up?
faqs.answer: You'll be asked to provide: your name and a display name for your profile, date of birth, gender, phone number, email, where you live, marital status, religious information, education and occupation, the qualities you're looking for in a partner, a profile photo, and other information needed to build your profile.

faqs.question: Can I use a nickname?
faqs.answer: Nusrah may allow a display name to protect your privacy, but the information you register with must be true and accurate.

faqs.question: Will my phone number be visible to everyone?
faqs.answer: No. Personal information like your phone number and email is protected and should not be shown publicly without your permission.

faqs.question: Can I upload my photo?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can add a photo suitable for your profile. Nusrah may review photos to ensure they meet the platform's rules and standards.

faqs.question: What is profile verification?
faqs.answer: Verification helps increase trust and safety among members by confirming that a user's key information can be verified.

faqs.question: Does Nusrah guarantee I'll find a partner?
faqs.answer: No. Nusrah cannot guarantee marriage or finding a particular partner. The platform provides an environment to meet, communicate, and choose carefully.

faqs.question: How do I search for a partner?
faqs.answer: You can use criteria such as: gender, age, location, marital status, education, occupation, religious practice, lifestyle, and other preferences for your partner.

faqs.question: Can I contact someone I'm interested in?
faqs.answer: Yes, if both profiles allow communication according to Nusrah's system. You can use the platform's internal messaging without needing to give out your phone number.

faqs.question: Can I block someone?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can block a member you don't want contacting you.

faqs.question: Can I report a profile?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can report a profile, message, or behavior that violates Nusrah's rules. Our team may investigate the report and take appropriate action.

faqs.question: How does Nusrah protect my safety?
faqs.answer: Nusrah aims to use a range of safety measures, including user verification, a reporting system, suspending accounts that violate the rules, and protecting personal information.

faqs.question: What role does a Wali/Guardian play?
faqs.answer: For users who choose to, Nusrah may offer a section to add Wali/Guardian information to support the process of finding a partner respectfully and with family involvement.

faqs.question: Is guardian information required?
faqs.answer: No, that section may be optional, depending on Nusrah's policy and system.

faqs.question: I forgot my password, what do I do?
faqs.answer: Click "Forgot Password?" on the Login page and follow the steps to recover your account.

faqs.question: Can I change my profile information?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can edit your information via Profile Settings, except for certain information that may require additional verification.

faqs.question: Can I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can request to delete your account via Account Settings or by contacting Nusrah Support.

faqs.question: Is Nusrah free?
faqs.answer: Nusrah may offer free services alongside paid services, depending on the available membership plan.

faqs.question: How are payments made?
faqs.answer: If the service you're using requires payment, Nusrah may offer various payment methods such as mobile money, card, or other methods accepted by the system.

faqs.question: Can payments be refunded?
faqs.answer: Refunds depend on the type of service, the plan you paid for, and Nusrah's Refund Policy.

faqs.question: Does Nusrah allow scams or fake accounts?
faqs.answer: No. Fake accounts, scams, fraud, threats, harassment, and misuse of the platform are violations of Nusrah's Terms.

faqs.question: What should I do if I suspect someone is a scammer?
faqs.answer: Don't send them money or your sensitive information. Block and report them immediately through the Report system, and Nusrah may investigate.

faqs.question: Can I ask another user for money?
faqs.answer: No. Asking or pressuring another user to send money, especially through deception, can lead to your account being suspended or closed.

faqs.question: Can my communications be monitored?
faqs.answer: Nusrah may process information as needed for safety, service operation, and preventing misuse, in accordance with its Privacy Policy.

faqs.question: Does Nusrah share my information with others?
faqs.answer: Nusrah aims to protect your personal information and handle it in accordance with its Privacy Policy and applicable law.

faqs.question: Can I meet someone I found on Nusrah in person?
faqs.answer: Yes, but you're advised to take precautions: make sure you've communicated enough beforehand, avoid sending money, and choose a safe, well-known place for a first meeting.

faqs.question: How do I contact Nusrah Support?
faqs.answer: Use the Help & Support / Contact Us section within Nusrah.co.tz for help with your account, profile, payments, safety, or to report a problem.

usalama.title: Nusrah Safety Center
usalama.subtitle: Your Safety Comes First
usalama.intro: Nusrah.co.tz aims to help you find a life partner in a way that is respectful, private, honest, and safe.

sections.heading: Protect Your Account
items: Never give anyone your password or OTP.
Don't reuse that password on other accounts.
Log out when using someone else's device.
Turn on Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) where available.
sections.note: Nusrah Support will never ask for your password.

sections.heading: Profile Verification
intro: Nusrah may use Phone Verification, Photo Verification, and Identity Verification to increase trust in profiles.
A verified profile may display a Verified Badge ✓.
sections.note: Remember: verification reduces risk, but it doesn't mean a person has no bad intentions at all.

sections.heading: Watch for Signs of a Scam
intro: Be careful if someone:
items: Declares love for you very quickly.
Asks for money or financial help.
Sends you a link you don't recognize.
Pressures you to leave Nusrah and communicate outside the platform right away.
Refuses video calls or meeting up for unclear reasons.
Asks for private photos or videos.
Uses emergency stories to get you to send money.
outro: Don't send anyone money just because you've started talking on Nusrah. Romance scams often exploit romantic trust to convince someone to hand over money or personal information. (Internet Crime Complaint Center)

sections.heading: Block & Report
intro: If you feel someone isn't safe:
BLOCK USER → Stops that user from contacting you.
REPORT USER → Sends a report to the Nusrah Safety Team.
You can report:
outro: Report and Block are essential safety features on any dating platform. (Safety Centre)

sections.heading: Protect Your Personal Information
intro: Don't share early on:
items: Private photos/videos you don't want shared.
outro: Your profile information should be kept to the minimum needed to protect your privacy. (eSafety Commissioner)

sections.heading: Communicate Within Nusrah
intro: We recommend staying on Nusrah Messages while you're still getting to know someone.
This keeps Report, Block, and Safety Tools available to you before you share your phone number or move to another platform.

sections.heading: Location Safety
intro: Don't give out your exact address, like "I live at house number…, street…, near…".
Instead, use general information like Dodoma, Dar es Salaam, Arusha, or Mwanza.
Avoid making your exact location public.

sections.heading: Before You Meet
intro: If you've decided to meet someone, do this:
items: Share who you're meeting and their profile.
Meet in a public, populated place.
Use your own transportation where possible.
Stay in touch with someone close to you during the trip.
outro: Safety guidelines recommend telling a friend/family member where you're going and having an exit plan in case things don't feel right. (eSafety Commissioner)

sections.heading: Family / Wali Support
intro: Since Nusrah is focused on marriage, a user may choose to involve a Wali, Guardian, Parent, or trusted person at appropriate stages of the search for a partner.
The goal: more transparency, respect, and safety on the path toward marriage.

sections.heading: If You're in Danger
intro: If someone is threatening, stalking, pressuring, or harming you:
items: Block and Report them on Nusrah.
If there's immediate physical danger, contact your local emergency authorities.
outro: Nusrah is not an emergency service; for immediate danger, seek help from the relevant authorities. (Safety Centre)

sections.heading: Personal Photos and Videos
intro: Don't send a photo or video that could be used to threaten or pressure you.
If someone threatens to share your photo or video: don't pay, don't send more photos, stop communicating, save evidence, and report the account.

sections.heading: There's No "Love Payment"
intro: Nusrah should never become a place for asking each other for money under the guise of romance.
Don't send money to someone you met online for:

sections.heading: Rules of Respect
intro: Every member is expected to uphold: Respect, Honesty, Privacy, Consent, Good Character, and Marriage Intentions.
Not allowed:
items: Using Nusrah for purposes other than marriage.

items: Connect people who are genuinely interested in marriage.
Facilitate respectful introductions between potential spouses.
Allow users to create marriage-oriented profiles.
Provide tools for searching and discovering compatible potential partners.
Promote responsible, respectful and transparent relationships.
Provide a safer digital environment for people seeking marriage.
